text: 第一课发生在早晨。我们要学会向家人说早安，问对方睡得怎么样，还要说自己已经准备好起床了。
Good 里的元音要短，嘴唇稍微收圆。Morning 的重音在第一个音节。两个词要自然连起来。
good. morning. Good morning. Did you sleep well? Yes, I did. I'm ready.
Good morning, Mia. Good morning, Mom. Did you sleep well? Yes, I did. Time to get up. Okay. I'm ready!
Good morning, Mia. Good morning, Mom. Did you sleep well? Yes, I did. Time to get up. Okay. I'm ready!
Good morning, Mia. Good morning, Mom. Did you sleep well? Yes, I did. Time to get up. Okay. I'm ready!
第二课发生在早餐桌。我们练习用 Can I have 来提出请求，用 Here you are 来递东西，最后别忘了说谢谢。
Can I 连起来时，can 要读轻一点。Please 中间的长音稍微拉长。Thank 开头，舌尖轻轻放在牙齿之间送气。
Can I? please. thank you. Can I have some milk, please? Here you are. Thank you.
Can I have some milk, please? Sure. Here you are. Thank you, Dad. You're welcome. Do you want some bread? Yes, please.
Can I have some milk, please? Sure. Here you are. Thank you, Dad. You're welcome. Do you want some bread? Yes, please.
Can I have some milk, please? Sure. Here you are. Thank you, Dad. You're welcome. Do you want some bread? Yes, please.
第三课是下雨天出门。我们要说今天的天气，还要学会提醒别人穿雨衣、带雨伞。
It's 是 It is 的缩写，结尾要听见轻轻的 ts。Raining 分成 rain 和 ing。Put on 连起来，中间不要停。
It's. raining. It's raining. put on. Put on your raincoat. Where are my boots?
It's raining today. I see the rain. Put on your raincoat. Where are my boots? They're by the door. Got them. Let's go!
It's raining today. I see the rain. Put on your raincoat. Where are my boots? They're by the door. Got them. Let's go!
It's raining today. I see the rain. Put on your raincoat. Where are my boots? They're by the door. Got them. Let's go!
第四课是在家准备晚餐。我们练习主动问 Can I help，再听懂摆盘子、拿杯子这样的简单任务。
Help 的最后让双唇合起来，发出轻轻的 p。The 的开头，舌尖轻轻放在牙齿之间。I can do it 里 do 更有力。
help. the table. I can do it. Can I help? Set the table, please.
Can I help? Yes, please. Set the table, please. Okay. I can do it. Please bring two cups. Here they are!
Can I help? Yes, please. Set the table, please. Okay. I can do it. Please bring two cups. Here they are!
Can I help? Yes, please. Set the table, please. Okay. I can do it. Please bring two cups. Here they are!
第五课要在客厅找玩具。我们练习 Where is my，和用 on、in、under 说清楚位置。
Where is 连起来说，中间不要停。Under 的重音在第一个音节。Isn't 是 is not 的缩写。
Where is? under. isn't. Where is my teddy bear? Look under the chair. No, it isn't.
Where is my teddy bear? Is it on the sofa? No, it isn't. Look under the chair. There it is! Thank you for helping me.
Where is my teddy bear? Is it on the sofa? No, it isn't. Look under the chair. There it is! Thank you for helping me.
Where is my teddy bear? Is it on the sofa? No, it isn't. Look under the chair. There it is! Thank you for helping me.
第六课是在放学回家以后。我们学会问对方感觉怎么样，也学会说自己累了、饿了或很开心。
How do you 在自然语速里会连起来。Tired 通常读成一个音节。A little 表示一点点。
How do you feel? tired. a little. I'm a little tired. Do you want to rest?
How do you feel? I'm a little tired. Do you want to rest? Yes, please. I'll get you some water. Thanks, Dad.
How do you feel? I'm a little tired. Do you want to rest? Yes, please. I'll get you some water. Thanks, Dad.
How do you feel? I'm a little tired. Do you want to rest? Yes, please. I'll get you some water. Thanks, Dad.
第七课来到教室，认识一位新同学。我们要会说自己的名字，问别人叫什么，并说很高兴认识你。
I'm 是 I am 的缩写。Name 中间的音像字母 A 的名字。Meet 中间的音要稍微拉长。
I'm Mia. name. meet. What's your name? Nice to meet you.
Hi! I'm Ben. Hi, Ben. I'm Mia. What's your name? My name is Mia. Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you, too.
Hi! I'm Ben. Hi, Ben. I'm Mia. What's your name? My name is Mia. Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you, too.
Hi! I'm Ben. Hi, Ben. I'm Mia. What's your name? My name is Mia. Nice to meet you. Nice to meet you, too.
第八课练习向同桌借文具。May I borrow 是非常实用的礼貌问法，借到以后要说谢谢。
May I 连起来说会更自然。Borrow 的重音在第一个音节。Pencil 也是前重后轻。
May I? borrow. pencil. May I borrow a pencil? Here you are.
May I borrow a pencil? Sure. Here you are. Thank you. You're welcome. Here is your pencil. Thanks!
May I borrow a pencil? Sure. Here you are. Thank you. You're welcome. Here is your pencil. Thanks!
May I borrow a pencil? Sure. Here you are. Thank you. You're welcome. Here is your pencil. Thanks!
第九课教孩子在课堂上真正有用的一句话。听不懂时不要沉默，可以礼貌地请老师再说一次。
I don't understand 里，don't 和 stand 更清楚。Understand 的重音在最后。Again 的第二个音节更重。
I don't understand. understand. again. Can you say it again, please?
Open your book, please. Sorry, I don't understand. That's okay. Can you say it again, please? Open your book. Oh, I understand now.
Open your book, please. Sorry, I don't understand. That's okay. Can you say it again, please? Open your book. Oh, I understand now.
Open your book, please. Sorry, I don't understand. That's okay. Can you say it again, please? Open your book. Oh, I understand now.
第十课发生在课间。我们练习怎样礼貌加入同学的游戏，以及怎样说轮到你、轮到我。
With 的结尾，舌尖轻放在牙齿之间并让声带振动。Your turn 里 turn 读得更重。问句末尾语调可以稍微上扬。
with you. your turn. It's your turn. Can I play with you?
Can I play with you? Sure! Come and play. What are you playing? We are playing catch. It's your turn. Great! Here I go!
Can I play with you? Sure! Come and play. What are you playing? We are playing catch. It's your turn. Great! Here I go!
Can I play with you? Sure! Come and play. What are you playing? We are playing catch. It's your turn. Great! Here I go!
第十一课是在学校吃午餐。我们要会说自己带了什么，也可以问同学喜不喜欢某种食物。
What do you 在自然语速中会连起来。Rice 结尾直接停在 s。And 在句子中可以读轻一点。
What do you have for lunch? rice. and. rice and chicken.
What do you have for lunch? I have rice and chicken. What about you? I have a sandwich and an apple. Do you like apples? Yes, I do!
What do you have for lunch? I have rice and chicken. What about you? I have a sandwich and an apple. Do you like apples? Yes, I do!
What do you have for lunch? I have rice and chicken. What about you? I have a sandwich and an apple. Do you like apples? Yes, I do!
最后一课把学校生活带回家。我们练习回答今天怎么样、学到了什么，以及最喜欢哪一部分。
How was 连起来时，was 可以读轻一点。Learned 结尾要保留轻轻的 d。Favorite 的重音在第一个音节。
How was school today? learned. I learned about animals. favorite. Art class was my favorite.
How was school today? It was great! What did you learn? I learned about animals. What was your favorite part? Art class was my favorite.
How was school today? It was great! What did you learn? I learned about animals. What was your favorite part? Art class was my favorite.
